textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Z=6 fixed defines carbon; A=Z+N counts nucleons and is not the bound atomic mass. N is discrete; stability is additional nuclear information, not inferred from the arithmetic.
textMathManualReview.independentManualCalculation: 7neutrons→A13;8→A14. Inverse N=A−6 returns7/8. Both outputs dimensionless.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: 13C/14C preserve the element while changing nuclide; stable13C/radioactive14C is an assigned fact. Two additions and an inverse subtraction, no calculator.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Single assigned events, nucleus daughter relative to parent. Alpha emission removes2protons/2neutrons; beta-minus converts a neutron to proton and emits electron/antineutrino; gamma changes excitation only.
textMathManualReview.independentManualCalculation: Alpha ΔZ−2,ΔA−4; beta-minus ΔZ+1,ΔA0. The actual tasks ask ΔZ and return−2/+1; gamma state returns0.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Distinguishes daughter nuclear charge from emitted electron charge. Charge conservation and unchanged nucleon count in beta-minus are explicit; no unassigned decay chain inferred.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Angles measured to the normal of the plane mirror. Asked opening is between geometric segments from the impact point towards source and reflected ray, not between the propagation velocity vectors.
textMathManualReview.independentManualCalculation: α=2θ;20°→40°,50°→100°. Inverse θ=α/2. At normal incidence opening0° even though propagation directions oppose.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Construction and inverse halving are explicit; prevents using180°−2θ for this different geometric quantity.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Thin convergent lens, paraxial parallel input; positive focal length. Power reciprocal of physical focal length in metres, reported m⁻¹. Formula f(m)/f(cm) denotes explicitly labelled numerical readings.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Fourfold longer focal length gives quarter power. Explicit centimetre/metre conversion avoids off-by100 reciprocal mistake; manual integer divisions.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Thin lens f=.10m, real object p>0, positive q towards emerging side. Finite output is image vergence1/q, not image distance at focus.
textMathManualReview.independentManualCalculation: V=10−100/p_cm D.5cm→−10D and q−10cm virtual;20cm→+5D and q+20cm real. p10cm→V0 with parallel output, not finite q. Inverse p_cm=100/(10−V) recovers5/20.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: The final physical formula1/q=1/(.10m)−1/p now declares p/q metres. Re-read confirms only this field changed; signs, finite-at-focus output and manual conversion/reciprocal steps remain correct.
